import json,sys,pathlib,statistics
b=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); rows=[]
for p in sorted(b.glob('r*_p*_*')):
 x=json.loads((p/'report.json').read_text()); r=x['rows'][0]; s=r['final']['raf_summary']; parts=p.name.split('_',3); rep=int(parts[0][1:]); pos=int(parts[1][1:]); mode=r['mode']; rows.append({'rep':rep,'pos':pos,'mode':mode,'fps':s['fps'],'mean_ms':s['mean_ms'],'p95_ms':s['p95_ms'],'max_ms':s['max_ms'],'ticks':r['final']['timerTicks'],'predecode':r.get('predecode_complete'),'error':r.get('error')})

for mode in ['idle','normal_blink','special_raw','special_predecoded']:
 z=[r for r in rows if r['mode']==mode]; print('MODE',mode,json.dumps({'n':len(z),'fps_median':statistics.median(r['fps'] for r in z),'fps_range':[min(r['fps'] for r in z),max(r['fps'] for r in z)],'mean_ms_median':statistics.median(r['mean_ms'] for r in z),'p95_ms_median':statistics.median(r['p95_ms'] for r in z),'max_ms_median':statistics.median(r['max_ms'] for r in z),'max_ms_max':max(r['max_ms'] for r in z),'errors':[r['error'] for r in z]},sort_keys=True))
raw=[r['fps'] for r in rows if r['mode']=='special_raw']; pre=[r['fps'] for r in rows if r['mode']=='special_predecoded']; print('PREDECODE_MINUS_RAW_FPS_MEDIAN',statistics.median(pre)-statistics.median(raw))
